profile_text.body:
monday.com is a publicly traded company headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, listed on a stock exchange under the ticker MNDY with a CIK of 0001845338. The company describes itself as an AI work platform designed for both people and AI agents, positioning the product around project execution, management, and operations carried out on a single platform. It markets its offering to a range of customer segments including small and medium-sized businesses, enterprises, and nonprofits.

The company's primary AI product is Monday.com AI, categorized as a notes, knowledge, and meetings tool that the company describes as a Work OS incorporating AI agents, project automation, and cross-functional data capabilities. The site emphasizes that its AI agents operate with contextual awareness before acting and that the platform includes enterprise-grade infrastructure covering data privacy, governance, permissions, and compliance. The held facts note Israeli data transfer considerations relevant to the product.

The held facts record 168 legal exposure items associated with Illinois but list no specific active cases. No MCP server presence is recorded for the company.
